'''Sacul Industries Group''' was a technology company comprised of multiple divisions which operated during the Galactic Civil War, and provided a variety of technology for [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] and other members of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. The group's slogan was "Across the land and deep into space, we keep the galaxy moving."<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>

==Divisions==
*[[Sacul Aerospace]]<ref name="ST2" />
*[[Droid Security Systems]]<ref name="ST2" />
*[[Interstellar Lightspeed Manufacturing]]<ref name="ST2" />
*[[Walkerskye Surveillance Network]]<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This organization was mentioned only in an advertisement on the video screen found exclusively in the queue of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="ST2" />

The name Sacul recurs in both versions of ''Star Tours'' as the last name of [[Egroeg Sacul]], a passenger paged over the public address system in the queue and whose name is [[George Lucas]] spelled backwards.<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=lucasfilm-easter-eggs-at-diseny-parks|text=Lucasfilm Fans, Be on the Lookout for These Easter Eggs at Disney Parks}}</ref>
